

                     **SERVO MOTOR CONTROL USING ARDUINO UNO**

- AIM

To design and implement a simple servo motor control system using Arduino UNO.

- INTRODUCTION

A servo motor is an actuator used to control the angular position of a mechanical component. In this project, an Arduino UNO is used to control the position of an SG90 servo motors

- APPARATUS REQUIRED

- [ ] Arduino UNO  
        
- [ ] SG90 Servo Motor  
        
- [ ] Jumper wires  
        
- [ ] USB cable  
        
- [ ] Computer/Laptop

- CIRCUIT CONNECTION

* Servo VCC (Red) → Arduino 5V  
    
* Servo GND (Brown/Black) → Arduino GND  
    
* Servo Signal (Orange/Yellow) → Arduino Digital Pin 9

- CONSTRUCTION

1\. Connect the servo motor to the Arduino UNO using jumper wires.

2\. Connect the power and ground terminals correctly.

![circuit](circuit.jpeg)  
3\. Connect the signal wire to a digital PWM pin.

4\. Connect Arduino UNO to the computer using a USB cable.

5\. Upload the required Arduino program.

- WORKING


- [ ]  Arduino receives the programmed instructions.  
        
- [ ]  It generates a PWM signal for the servo motor.  
        
- [ ]  The servo receives the signal and rotates to the required angle.  
        
- [ ]  By changing the PWM signal, different angular positions can be obtained.  
        
- [ ]  Thus, the servo motor can be controlled accurately using Arduino.  
    


- APPLICATIONS

- Robotic arms  
    
- Automatic doors  
    
- Robot vehicles  
    
- Camera positioning systems  
    
- Electronic control mechanisms

- RESULT

Thus, the servo motor was successfully interfaced with Arduino UNO and its angular position was controlled using PWM signals.
